market_summary: Both GBPUSD and BTCUSD are consolidating inside their respective session Value Areas during the London session. GBPUSD is attempting to push through VAH and EMA50 but suffers from bearish CVD divergence and lack of RVOL expansion. BTCUSD remains compressed below VWAP and POC with low volume and muted momentum. Flat exposure is recommended across both assets until clear directional breakouts emerge.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7 confluence points: 1) VP Context: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.32531, VAH 1.32729) and trading above POC 1.32577, pushing near VAH. 2) CVD: Bearish (-2791.36) with negative slope (-1529.98), diverging noticeably from the recent bullish push. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION, highly active. 4) Trend: Price is slightly above VWAP (1.32653) and hovering right at EMA50 (1.32688) with flat-to-slight downward higher timeframe tilt. 5) ATR Bands: Trading mid-to-upper channel (ATR Upper 1.32774). 6) RVOL: RVOL is 1.292 (no yellow spikes on this latest push, last spike was 7 bars ago). 7) S/R: Testing resistance around S/R 1.32661 and VAH 1.32729 below Session High 1.32809. GEX is null. Given diverging bearish CVD and price capping right at VAH/EMA50 resistance inside VA without fresh breakout volume, setup is conflicting. Prefer HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral; reclaiming VWAP and EMA50 from below
